subject: BlueMarble onboarding: activation code / PO issuance & line item adjustments
messages:
From: Natalie Reid <natalie@bluemarble.io>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Supply Admin <supply-admin@bluemarble.io>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding forms + missing PO number for November activation

Hi Ben —

We're finishing the vendor intake for BlueMarble and hit two blockers before we can start the Dedicated trial next week:

1) The intake form we uploaded earlier (attached) was accepted, but our procurement team says they still don't see a PO number assigned on your side for the Nov 30 start. We received an email referencing a provisional code but not a formal PO. Can you confirm the issued PO number and allocation bucket?

2) A few line items ("additional inference hours" and "streaming tokens") in the draft invoice don't match the SKU labels in our ERP; procurement asked for line-level codes so they can map spend caps correctly. I'm attaching our mapping export (CSV snippet).

We need this sorted to avoid delay with our finance team. If you can route a provisional PO or internal activation code today, that would be ideal.

Thanks —
Natalie Reid
Head of Platform Ops, BlueMarble Analytics
natalie@bluemarble.io
+1 415-555-0124

Attachments: blue_marble_vendor_form.pdf (vendor intake), po-draft-4921.csv (line mapping snippet)

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Reid <natalie@bluemarble.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding forms + missing PO number for November activation

Thanks Natalie — looping in Monica from procurement to confirm the issuance.

Quick answers while Monica checks:
- I do see a provisional activation code in our intake system (ACT-4921-PROV). That was meant to let infra start the provisioning while finance finalizes the PO. I can share that now if it helps unblock staging.
- Monica: BlueMarble flagged two SKU mismatches — "inference hours" and "streaming tokens" — that need your code mapping so their ERP can apply the spend cap. They provided a CSV.

Natalie, if you can confirm whether a provisional activation is acceptable to start internal deployment (non-billable until formal PO issues), we can proceed immediately.

— Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 646-555-0789

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Reid <natalie@bluemarble.io>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 13:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding forms + missing PO number for November activation

Hi all — internal procurement update.

1) PO issuance: We have generated a provisional PO record while finance creates the formal PO document. The internal reference is PO-RED-4921-P (provisional). We will convert this to the formal PO-4921 once the signed PO comes back from BlueMarble. For your procurement team, please use the internal reference PO-RED-4921-P for now — it will tie to the activation code.

2) Spend caps: The provisional spend cap is set to $45,000 USD for the first 30 days (trial window). That covers the SKU bands listed below. If your ERP requires a specific spend bucket code, map to our internal spend bucket SB-TRIAL-11.

3) Line-item mapping corrections: Reviewed the CSV you attached. I made three changes to the SKU labels so they align with our ledger:
  - "inference_hours" -> SKU: INF-HR-XL (line 1)
  - "streaming_tokens" -> SKU: STR-TKN-STD (line 2)
  - "support_oncall" -> SKU: SUP-24/7 (line 5)

I uploaded an updated PO draft (attached) that includes the corrected SKU codes and the provisional internal PO reference. Please confirm these exact SKU labels with your ERP team so we can avoid rejections when the formal PO is submitted.

Notes: This provisional issuance does not release funds. Once we receive the signed PO document (scanned PDF or DocuSign link), we will convert to a billable PO and confirm the final PO number within 24 hours.

Attachments: po-draft-4921.csv (updated with SKU corrections)

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0202

From: Natalie Reid <natalie@bluemarble.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding forms + missing PO number for November activation

Monica / Ben — thank you. Confirmed with our ERP: mapping to INF-HR-XL and STR-TKN-STD is fine, and SB-TRIAL-11 will be used for the provisional spend cap. BlueMarble is comfortable starting staging with the provisional activation (ACT-4921-PROV) and the provisional reference PO-RED-4921-P; we will route the signed PO via DocuSign today and send the link when done.

I'll follow up once the DocuSign is out — can you confirm an expected turn-around after we send the signed doc? Last time conversion took 2 business days.

— Natalie
Natalie Reid
Head of Platform Ops, BlueMarble Analytics
